title: Castelion raises $1B at $13B valuation to mass-produce hypersonic missiles
summary: Castelion, a defense tech startup founded by former SpaceX executives, has secured a $1 billion Series C funding round at a $13 billion valuation. The company aims to address the U.S. hypersonic missile gap by leveraging faster and more cost-effective manufacturing processes. The funding will support production of its Blackbeard hypersonic missiles and other weapons at its New Mexico facility. Castelion has already secured over $500 million in U.S. military contracts.
key_points: Castelion is a missile startup founded in 2022 by former SpaceX executives.
The company raised $1 billion in a Series C round at a $13 billion valuation, co-led by Andreessen Horowitz, Carlyle, and JP Morgan Chase.
Castelion focuses on mass-producing hypersonic missiles (Mach 5+) at lower costs and faster speeds than traditional defense contractors.
The startup has secured over $500 million in U.S. military contracts to date.
Funds will be used to produce Blackbeard hypersonic missiles and other weapons at its New Mexico facility.
The Pentagon seeks to close the hypersonic missile gap with China, driving demand for Castelion's technology.
